# meta-hypertools -- LLM corpus

> Version `0.5.0` (see `pyproject.toml`). Fleet MCP orchestrator: scaffolding, analysis, runtime, diagnostics, repo inspiration, cold-start and cold-install probes, routing, harness generation. **Curated manifest** -- no live MCP configs or machine paths. Privacy: [docs/PRIVACY.md](docs/PRIVACY.md).

Generated: 2026-09-29 (hand-maintained; refresh after tool or env changes)

## 2026-09 additions (unreleased)

- **Agentic chat** - `services/chat_agent_service.py`: orientation +
  personality + live tool catalog preprompt, bounded loop (max 10),
  Ollama/OpenAI tool-call formats, in-process execution via ToolService,
  4k result truncation with trace preview. Default-deny confirm gate on
  18 read-only portmanteau operations; paused runs in memory (30-min TTL).
- **New REST endpoints** - chat/context, chat/agent, chat/agent/confirm,
  inspire/presets, inspire/search, standards, session-docs DELETE (see
  llms.txt REST API block).
- **New pages** - Fleet Standards (143 handbook docs, grid/list), Repo
  Inspiration Discover tab (presets, faves, markers), agent-mode Chat with
  trace + approval card, Assess Reports and Session Docs upgraded to the
  list-page standard (search/filter/sort/paginate/count).
- **Portability** - `FLEET_REPOS_ROOT`/`REPOS_DIR` env + repo-relative
  defaults replace hardcoded dev paths; handbook resolution covers clones
  inside the repos root; relaxed pre-commit biome gate (lint only).
- **Docs** - README split (86-line welcome + `docs/WORKFLOWS.md` missions);
  repo is public (`meta-hypertools`).

## 2026-08 modernization (v0.5.1)

- **Standards checker v2** - scripts/check-repo-standards.ps1 (synced to
  mcp-central-docs/sota-scripts/repo-standards/): FastMCP 3.4 floor,
  uv.lock over requirements.txt, assets/icon.png, 3-4-100 prompt word
  gates (system 3000+, user 4000+, examples 100+), mcpb/ layout support,
  live standards doc refs, ASCII-only output. Run: just health.
- **MCPB bundle at the 3-4-100 gate** - mcpb/assets: icon.png (256x256),
  prompts/system.md (3154w), prompts/user.md (4226w), examples.json (101).
- **Fullstack builder** (scripts/fullstack-builder.ps1, 2768 lines):
  emits React 18 + Vite + Tailwind + Bun webapp with FastMCP 3.4 backend,
  SQLite (members/products/orders), membership roster, onboarding wizard,
  fleet-standard chat (skill-first preprompt, personalities, example
  prompts, Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM probe), webshop, APScheduler jobs
  (patrol demo), Logs ring buffer, API Docs page, Playwright e2e, CI,
  optional Tauri 2.0 wrapper. Flags: -Interactive, -IncludeTauri,
  -IncludeVoice, -IncludeScheduler, etc. Ports adjacent in 10700-11500.
- **Auth** - src/meta_mcp/auth.py: X-Wurst-Auth middleware protects
  /api/analysis, /api/remediation, /api/patch, /api/fleet/scan,
  /api/v1/fleet/start|stop|restart. Token unset = local-dev bypass.
- **demo-app** - D:\Dev\repos\demo-app (11140/11141), IDEAS.md roadmap.

## Tools

All tools are registered via FastMCP suites in `src/meta_mcp/mcp_server.py`. Call `help()` for the live catalog.

### Discovery and overview

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `help` | List every meta-hypertools tool (primary discovery entry) |
| `find_mcp_tools` | Search toolsets by keyword |
| `list_mcp_tools` | Alias of `help` with lower default cap |
| `show_mcp_overview` | Short platform overview and next steps |
| `inspire_repo_help` | Parameter reference for inspiration tools |

### Fleet runtime

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `get_fleet_status` | Audit fleet runtime status |
| `launch_fleet_app` | Start a fleet application |
| `stop_fleet_app` | Stop a fleet application |
| `refresh_mcp_fleet` | Sync fleet registry metadata |
| `open_mcp_launcher` | Open fleet management UI |
| `ping_fleet` | Ping entire fleet |

### Fleet probes

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `fleet_startup_probe` | Cold-start probe: `start.ps1`, health, dirty log |
| `fleet_startup_probe_report` | Latest cold-start report JSON |
| `fleet_cold_install_probe` | Cold-install: INSTALL.md, mcpb (Claude), stdio smoke |
| `fleet_cold_install_probe_report` | Latest cold-install report JSON |

HTTP mirrors: `POST/GET /api/v1/fleet/startup-probe/*`, `POST/GET /api/v1/fleet/cold-install/*`

### Diagnostics

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `scan_mcp_unicode` | Unicode logging / docstring safety audit |
| `validate_mcp_pwsh` | PowerShell native cmdlet standards |
| `audit_mcp_implementation` | Stub / honesty scan |
| `audit_mcp_surface` | FastMCP surface audit |
| `audit_ide_integration` | IDE integration health |
| `validate_tool_schema` | Validate tool parameters |
| `benny_handshake` | Physical interrupt protocol for critical ops |

### Analysis and depot

Portmanteau: `analysis_ops(operation="runts"|"status"|"codebase"|"list_depot"|"get_depot_run"|"publish_mcd")`.

Checks 40+ 2026 fleet standards: FastMCP version, web stack (Bun/Biome/Tailwind/Zustand/Lucide), Tauri/NSIS, docs (llms.txt/glama.json/.env.example), testing (Playwright/CUA-NSIS), safety (session context, CORS, --bak/--dryrun). Outputs structured **remediation_todo** grouped P0/P1/P2.

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `analysis_ops` | Portmanteau: runt scan, repo status, codebase digest, depot management |
| `deep_scan_repo` | Deep repository scan |
| `verify_exploit` | Grounded exploit verification |
| `generate_patch` | Generate patch for verified exploit |

### Repository inspiration (GitHub, no clone)

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `inspire_repo` | Portmanteau: structure / files / patterns / help |
| `inspire_repo_structure` | Filtered file tree |
| `inspire_repo_files` | Fetch selected source files |
| `inspire_repo_patterns` | Architecture study pack |
| `inspire_repo_workflow` | Multi-step study with optional sampling |
| `inspire_repo_structure_card` | Prefab UI structure card |

### Server management

|------|---------|

| `list_mcp_servers` | List running servers |

## Environment

| Variable | Default / note | Purpose |
|----------|----------------|---------|
| `HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | API bind address |
| `PORT` | `10718` | API + static UI port |
| `REPOS_DIR` | `~/repos` | Fleet repo scan root |
| `MCP_CENTRAL_DOCS_ROOT` | `{REPOS_DIR}/mcp-central-docs` | Optional handbook clone |
| `WURST_AUTH_TOKEN` | unset | Enables auth on protected API paths when set |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | unset | Higher GitHub API rate limits |
| `META_MCP_NODE_LABEL` | OS hostname | Override node name in heartbeat (use `local` for privacy) |
| `META_MCP_FLEET_DEPOT` | `~/.meta_mcp/fleet` | Probe reports and manifests |
| `META_MCP_FLEET_PROBES_ROOT` | `fleet_probes/scripts` | Vendored probe scripts |
| `FLEET_REPOS_ROOT` | parent of install | Fleet probe repo root |
| `FLEET_PROBE_RUN` | set by probe | Redirect child logs during cold-start |
| `META_MCP_ANALYSIS_DEPOT` | `~/.meta_mcp/analysis` | Analysis depot |
| `META_MCP_PREFAB_APPS` | on | Set `0` to skip Prefab App tool registration |

Copy [.env.example](.env.example) to `.env`. Never commit `.env`.

---

## Run

### Install

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/meta-hypertools.git
cd meta-mcp
uv sync --group dev
Copy-Item .env.example .env
# Edit .env: REPOS_DIR, WURST_AUTH_TOKEN, optional GITHUB_TOKEN
```

### Web dashboard + API

```powershell
uv run meta-mcp
# http://127.0.0.1:10718
```

Or `.\start.bat` when present. Vite dev UI: `just web-dev` → port `10719`.

### stdio MCP (IDE)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "meta-mcp": {
      "command": "uv",
      "args": ["run", "meta-mcp-server"],
      "cwd": "/absolute/path/to/meta-mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Adjust `cwd` to your clone. Restart the IDE after config changes.

### Useful commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `just` | Recipe menu |
| `just tools` | Dump registered MCP tools |
| `uv run python scripts/dump_mcp_tools.py` | Same tool dump |

---

## Architecture

```
web_sota (React)  <->  FastAPI /api/v1  <->  FastMCP (stdio + in-process)
                              |
                    Services (fleet, analysis, inspiration, ...)
                              |
              fleet_probes/scripts/*.ps1  ->  dev-host probes
              ~/.meta_mcp/fleet/          ->  reports, manifests
```

- **Package:** `src/meta_mcp/`
- **Active UI:** `web_sota/` (`frontend/` is legacy)
- **Probe scripts:** `fleet_probes/` (vendored; MCD not required at runtime)
- **Tool suites:** `src/meta_mcp/tools/registries/*.py`

Fleet probe outcomes include `stack_ok`, `stack_degraded` (dirty console), `start_failed`, cold-install `mcpb_*` / `stdio_*`. mcpb applies to **Claude Desktop only**.

---

## Fleet probes (operator)

| Probe | Question |
|-------|----------|
| Cold-start | Does `start.ps1` bring up stack; is console clean? |
| Cold-install | Can consumer follow `INSTALL.md` / mcpb / stdio? |

Dashboard: Fleet → Cold-start / Cold-install tabs. Reports: `~/.meta_mcp/fleet/reports/`.

---

## Troubleshooting

1. **No fleet repos found** -- set `REPOS_DIR` in `.env` to your clones parent directory.
2. **Probe scripts fail on Linux/macOS** -- cold-start/cold-install probes are PowerShell/Windows-oriented.
3. **401/403 on API writes** -- set `WURST_AUTH_TOKEN` in `.env` and send header `X-Wurst-Auth`.
4. **Repo inspiration rate limited** -- set `GITHUB_TOKEN` in `.env`.
5. **Dashboard empty tool list** -- run `uv run meta-mcp-server` once or check `GET /api/v1/mcp/catalog`; use Tool Lab after backend is up.

---

## Privacy reminder

Tools that read IDE configs, log tails, or probe captures may surface **secrets or hostnames**. Scrub before sharing. See [docs/PRIVACY.md](docs/PRIVACY.md).
